Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing street legal motorcycles to stop and proceed through traffic signals that fail to operate because of the motorcycle's size.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motorcycles at traffic signals; adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any provision of law to the contrary, the operatorof a street legal motorcycle approaching a left turn intersection thatis controlled by a triggered traffic control signal using a vehicledetection device that is inoperative due to the size of the streetlegal motorcycle shall come to a full and complete stop at theintersection. If the left turn signal fails to operate after one cycleof the traffic signal, the operator may, after exercising due care,proceed to turn left. It is not a defense to a violation of RCW46.61.050 that the driver of a motorcycle proceeded under the beliefthat a traffic control signal used a vehicle detection device or wasinoperative due to the size of the motorcycle when the signal did notuse a vehicle detection device or that any such device was not in fact p. 1 EHB 1466inoperative due to the size of the motorcycle.
